pin_policy: exact immutable release commit; release gate fails if v1.17.5 resolves to any other commit
integration_model: pinned Geth v1.17.5 plus maintained node420 protocol patchset; wrapper launches the patched binary
required_patch_points: execution header extraData commitment to the batch root
atomic payload invalidation on system-call failure
no public RPC surface for native 420 system-call synthesis
custom_engine_namespace: engine420_* required for consensus-system-call batch transport unless an equivalent authenticated standard Engine API field is adopted before mainnet freeze
